from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from modules.worker_ingress import service
from modules.worker_ingress.semantic_capabilities import (
    registered_capabilities,
    resolve_capability,
)

USER = {"email": "admin@example.com"}

REQUEST = {
    "objective": "Certificar Gate3B SQL READ_ONLY de RRHH Custodia.",
    "bounded_context": "RRHH_CUSTODIA",
    "mode": "READ_ONLY",
    "capability": "RRHH_CUSTODIA_GATE3B_SQL_PREFLIGHT",
    "constraints": {},
}


def test_capability_registered_read_only():
    assert "RRHH_CUSTODIA_GATE3B_SQL_PREFLIGHT" in registered_capabilities()
    capability = resolve_capability("RRHH_CUSTODIA_GATE3B_SQL_PREFLIGHT")
    assert capability.modes == ("READ_ONLY",)


def test_expansion_is_sql_readonly_and_non_mutating():
    job = service.build_semantic_job(REQUEST, current_user=USER)

    assert job["mode"] == "READ_ONLY"
    assert job["production_allowed"] is False
    assert job["actions"] == []
    assert len(job["checks"]) == 1
    assert job["checks"][0]["type"] == "sql_readonly_audit"
    assert len(job["checks"][0]["queries"]) == 7


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "constraints",
    [
        {"sql": "SELECT 1"},
        {"actions": []},
        {"checks": []},
        {"production_allowed": False},
        {"paths": ["backend"]},
    ],
)
def test_caller_cannot_override_sql_contract(constraints):
    with pytest.raises(
        service.WorkerIngressError,
        match="SEMANTIC_CONSTRAINTS_UNSUPPORTED",
    ):
        service.build_semantic_job(
            {**REQUEST, "constraints": constraints},
            current_user=USER,
        )


def test_other_context_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(
        service.WorkerIngressError,
        match="SEMANTIC_BOUNDED_CONTEXT_UNSUPPORTED",
    ):
        service.build_semantic_job(
            {**REQUEST, "bounded_context": "FINANZAS"},
            current_user=USER,
        )

objective: Agregar una capability semantica bounded y fail-closed para RRHH_CUSTODIA Gate3B SQL preflight. Debe usar mode READ_ONLY en el ingress semantico y expandir internamente a un check sql_readonly_audit con consultas hardcodeadas por la capability. El caller NO puede suministrar SQL, actions, checks, production_allowed, requester, repo ni branch. No modificar schemas.py, routes.py, service.py, Core, dispatcher, publisher ni componentes transversales fuera del scope. No ejecutar SQL ni tocar Produccion.
